title: Sean McVay: Tutu Atwell trade had "nothing to do" with possible Puka Nacua suspension

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay: Tutu Atwell trade had "nothing to do" with possible Puka Nacua suspension
sources.description: The Rams brought wide receiver Tutu Atwell back to the team in a trade with the Dolphins on Thursday and the timing of the deal led to questions about another member of the team's receiving corps.
